aiDetective.title: 🔍 AI Detective
aiDetective.subtitle: Guess which activities use AI.
aiDetective.instructionLevelSelect: Pick a level that's right for you!
aiDetective.instructionPlay: Read the situation card, then choose Has AI or No AI.

teachRobot.title: 🤖 Teach the Robot
teachRobot.subtitle: Teach the robot with examples.
teachRobot.instructionLevelSelect: Pick a level that's right for you!
teachRobot.instructionPlay: Help the robot label each object below. Read the hints carefully!

teachableMachine.title: 📷 Mini AI Training
teachableMachine.subtitle: Teach AI to recognize images right in your browser.
teachableMachine.instruction: The camera runs locally so the robot learns from examples. Photos are not sent to the server. 🔒

promptMagic.title: Prompt Magic
promptMagic.subtitle: Build prompts to guide AI.
promptMagic.instructionLevelSelect: Pick a level to practice prompt magic!
promptMagic.instructionPlay: Pick blocks below to build a great prompt, then send it to Prompt Coach for a score!

oopsAiMistake.title: 🤔 AI Can Be Wrong
oopsAiMistake.subtitle: AI is not always correct.
oopsAiMistake.instructionLevelSelect: Pick a level that's right for you!
oopsAiMistake.instructionPlay: Read the AI's answer and see if you spot any mistakes.

buddyBot.title: 💬 Buddy Bot Chat
buddyBot.subtitle: Chat safely with your study robot.
buddyBot.instruction: Chat with Buddy Bot, your learning robot.

imageStudio.title: AI Image Studio
imageStudio.subtitle: Write fun prompts to make learning art with Buddy Bot!
imageStudio.instruction: Pick safe blocks. Every image must be labeled as AI-made.

dataSorter.title: 🗂️ Data Sorter
dataSorter.subtitle: Sort data so AI learns safely.
dataSorter.instruction: Read each data card, then choose: good data, noisy data, or private info.

aiSafetyQuest.title: 🛡️ AI Safety Quest
aiSafetyQuest.subtitle: Make safe choices when using AI.
aiSafetyQuest.instruction: Read the scenario, then pick: do it, don't do it, or ask a grown-up.

robotCommands.title: Robot Commands
robotCommands.subtitle: Order steps one by one — robots don't guess magic.
robotCommands.instructionLevelSelect: Pick a level that's right for you!
robotCommands.instructionPlay: Tap commands to line them up. Press Run to watch Buddy Bot move step by step!

aiRecommendations.title: AI Suggestions
aiRecommendations.subtitle: AI suggests from patterns it has seen — it can't read minds.
aiRecommendations.instruction: See what your friend likes lately, then pick what Buddy Bot should suggest!
